facts.fact: The Executive Mansion announced on 28 April 2026 that Executive Order No. 163, signed 22 April 2026, requires the new Office of Technology, Digitalization and Innovation (OTDI) to submit the first release of a Government Interoperability Framework within 180 days; the release is a deadline, and no drafting or published text is reported.
